objective: Qualify one narrow RepoAuditor-owned JavaScript/TypeScript dynamic shell-execution rule with manufactured controls and mechanism-specific advisory pre/post evidence before considering any broader supplemental Semgrep coverage.

scope.candidate_mechanism: A variable or concatenated command is passed to child_process.exec or child_process.execSync, including destructured aliases and direct member calls.
scope.candidate_claim: Review dynamic shell-command construction for attacker control, reachability, and exploitability.
not_a_claim: The sink is reachable in a deployed product.
The rule estimates real-world precision or recall.
excluded_from_initial_rule: spawn argument-vector execution with shell disabled

frozen_acquisition_pairs.mechanism: OS command injection through caller-controlled gcov options interpolated into a shell command

target_match_requires: overlap with the frozen target line range
differential_contract.unrelated_candidates: Retain exact stable, pre-only, and post-only identity counts separately. Never transfer an unrelated candidate into target recovery because it shares a file or aggregate count.

execution_and_provenance.required_precondition: The full production scanner deployment canary passes before qualification.
execution_and_provenance.official_baseline: Run through the pinned official Semgrep adapter and retain its existing configuration digest, rule count, status, and candidate attribution.
execution_and_provenance.supplemental_pass: Run separately through the production Semgrep adapter with its own reviewed file, digest, rule count, status, and semgrep-supplemental candidate attribution.

promotion_criteria: Both manufactured positive cases are raised by the exact supplemental rule.
Both manufactured negative cases are absent.
The codecov-node pre-fix target is matched by rule, file, citation, and line.
The codecov-node patched target is not matched.
Every unrelated candidate and all five pair-level differential outcomes are retained.
The supplemental configuration has a verified digest and nonzero rule count.
No candidate becomes a label, ground-truth record, classifier score, or review acquisition entry.
failure_policy: Retain and report any control failure, stable target signal, patched-only signal, complete miss, scanner failure, or provenance failure. Do not revise the cohort, controls, target identity, or rule acceptance criteria after observing results.
pr_sequence: Freeze this protocol, controls, and generic differential harness before the supplemental rule exists.
Implement the rule, execute qualification, retain results, and integrate the separately attributable production pass in a second PR.
